description: Task Stream PRO – Process Flow Chart is the professional edition of Softcial’s Task Stream visual, designed for project teams and analysts who need powerful ways to explore and present task structures. This custom visual enables users to map complex processes, track progress, and highlight resource allocation, all directly within Power BI. With advanced features like multi-level drilldown, effort-based task sizing, and customizable shapes and styles, Task Stream PRO brings project reporting to life with clarity, structure, and style. Key Features Drilldown Navigation – Navigate through multiple task levels to explore sub-tasks and nested structures while keeping the view clean and focused. Effort-Based Task Sizing – Task containers scale dynamically based on effort values, helping visualize workload and resource distribution instantly. Customizable Statuses – Define your own task statuses. You can customize the color to display the tasks based on their status. Task Shape Customization – Choose between arrows, rectangles, or parallelograms for more flexible and visually distinctive representations, depending on the report’s design or purpose. All features from Free version – Personalize colors, fonts, and sizes for tasks and milestones to match branding or reporting needs.
